_comment: Maps a city's local/native-language name to the canonical English name used as the destination key in direct_flights.json. Applied to every show's city field (via shows_common.normalize_city) before it's used for cross-source deduplication or the flight-hub lookup in enrich_flights.py, so the same real show reported in different languages by different sources (e.g. Bandsintown often uses the venue's local language, Ticketmaster usually English) collapses into one entry instead of two. Add an entry here whenever a new mismatch like this turns up -- same maintenance pattern as city_hub_overrides.json.
